cross_axis_notes.text: Seller withdrawals and payouts per legal entity and currency (two parallel systems, legacy wallet and ledger payouts; the currency field is parsed and unused in the statement and payout models, Discovery E20-F01, F08) belong to the wallet and finance units. K-10 only requires the app to format amounts per market.
Seller shipping methods and third-party delivery have no destination or eligibility (GCC-16, E20-F12). The shipping unit owns the backend rules; the app only displays them.

Seller coupons and clearance sales have no market or currency dimension (GCC-17, E20-F13), and #52 changes who may edit an admin-assigned coupon. The campaigns unit owns the rules; K-17 lists the owner decision about the app's buttons.

Two writers of products.current_stock (ledger path and quantity-update) and provider-held stock shown only as an error text (E20-F05, F16) belong to the inventory unit. K-04 needs a per-market stock read from it.

Seller terms and business pages shown at login are fetched with no market context (GCC-11, Discovery E19 s.4). The policy unit decides per-country texts; the app only needs a market parameter once they exist.

Maintenance in the app is global (vendor_app switch) and blocks the whole app; a paused market (GCC-12) must keep order handling, refunds and payouts working for the seller. The store-operations unit owns the rule; K-04 and K-11 need a paused-market state in the app.

The seller app's order address edit sends free-text fields without region_id, city_id or country (E20-F10) while the central address system keys everything by ids (docs/address/README.md). The address and orders units own the contract.

Admin, AdminRole and module_access preservation and the admin-panel staff country scopes (GCC-14c, lavkoo#74, #77, #82) belong to the admin-panel unit. K-08 and K-09 cover only the seller principal and seller staff.

Backend notification services (SellerNotifier, PushNotificationTrait, customer and marketing FCM topics, device-token storage) belong to the notification unit. K-11 states what the app needs from them.

The app health reporter sends platform, version, sessions and crashes only, so it cannot tell the seller app from the customer app or one market from another (E19-F16). Monitoring belongs to the operations and security units.

The platform Super Admin shell (app#4 and app#6: second factor, sessions, 94 + 43 Arabic keys, a CI step with the flag on) is unit L. It shares assets/language/en.json and ar.json with the market chain (the only two overlapping files) and its All Markets selector must not reuse the seller's stored market.

Backend POS wallet debit rounding and units (lavkoo#35 D18, #36) and the wallet chain #9 to #15, which sits in neither integration tree, belong to the wallet and payments units. K-06 needs only the Idempotency-Key, the refusal handling and the outbox scope.

field_corrections.field: criterion 'Gateway callbacks and courier or marketplace webhooks are outside the storefront and sale middleware'
field_corrections.problem: Wrong for gateway callbacks. RouteServiceProvider::mapBetaWebRoutes wraps all of routes/web/routes.php in ['web','storefront',...], so payment/*/callback, payment-success, payment-fail and web-payment run inside the storefront middleware as the default storefront (that is why PR 53 binds the recorded storefront; StorefrontPaymentCallbackTest says so). The webhooks are mapped outside the storefront middleware; the web gateway callbacks and returns sit in the storefront group (served as the default storefront) and are finished in the recorded storefront by PR 53 (CODED; no route-level test).

StorefrontResolver::fromConfig() replaces a broken or inactive default with the built-in Saudi storefront while storefronts are off (ResolveStorefrontMiddlewareTest test_while_switched_off_a_missing_or_broken_configuration_still_serves_saudi, case 'an inactive default country'), and fails the request only while they are on (test_switched_on_an_inactive_default_country_fails_the_request_instead_of_serving_another_storefront). (2) While off, requests resolve to the configured default country (test_while_switched_off_a_valid_configuration_keeps_its_own_default_country), Saudi only as shipped. (3) Grandfathering is config grandfathered ['SA'], keyed to SA and not to the default role, so a different default would not inherit it.
field_corrections.replacement: Criterion 2: 'The resolver constructor refuses a default that is not configured or not active, with storefronts off or on; at request level fromConfig() falls back to built-in Saudi while off and fails the request while on.' Criterion 3: 'The Saudi storefront (grandfathered in config) is never refused for lack of legal rows; a different default would need its own rows.' done_in_drafts: 'while off every request resolves to the configured default country, Saudi as shipped'.
